dashboard.title: Your day at a glance
dashboard.body: Caseload, shelter beds, the hotline and what needs attention, the moment staff sign in.

cases-overview.title: One client, every service
cases-overview.body: Legal advocacy, a shelter bed and counseling for one client, held together in one case file.
cases-overview.vo: Elena came to you for legal help, a shelter bed, and counseling. In VS360, that's one client, and one case file.

cases-consent.title: Demographics, by consent
cases-consent.body: Demographics are kept for each case. When the client has given consent, your edits save immediately.
cases-consent.vo: Demographics are kept for each case. If the client has already given consent, your edits save right away.

cases-documents.title: Documents for e-signature
cases-documents.body: Send documents for signature by the client, staff, or both. Clients sign in the NECX app.
cases-documents.vo: Send documents for signature, and the client signs right in the NECX app.

cases-notes.title: Case notes
cases-notes.body: Notes for your team, kept on the case.

cases-chat.title: Secure case chat
cases-chat.body: Message the client right on the case.
cases-chat.vo: Chat with the client, right on the case.

cases-staff.title: Staff tagging
cases-staff.body: Tag the staff working the case.
cases-staff.vo: Tag the staff working the case,

cases-partners.title: Partner agency tagging
cases-partners.body: Tag the partner agencies in your network that are helping.

cases-preassessment.title: Send a pre-assessment
cases-preassessment.body: Send it to a new or existing client in a few steps.
cases-preassessment.vo: Then send a pre-assessment to a new or existing client.

referral-sharing.title: Referrals: share only what you choose
referral-sharing.body: Refer a case to a partner agency, and pick exactly what goes with it.
referral-sharing.vo: Referrals: send a case to a partner, and choose exactly what goes with it.

hotline-command.title: Your numbers, your lines
hotline-command.body: Dedicated hotline numbers for your agency, each line answered by your own team.
hotline-command.vo: Get dedicated hotline numbers for your agency. Your numbers, your lines.

hotline-callbacks.title: Callbacks that don't slip
hotline-callbacks.body: Every promised callback is scheduled with a date and owner. Overdue ones are flagged.
hotline-callbacks.vo: Every callback is scheduled, and overdue ones are flagged, so nothing slips.

hotline-missed.title: No missed call forgotten
hotline-missed.body: Missed calls wait in their own list, by line, ready to call back.
hotline-missed.vo: Missed calls wait in their own list, ready to return.

hotline-log.title: Every call, on the record
hotline-log.body: Line, staff, category and outcome for every call. Filter it, or export to CSV.
hotline-log.vo: Every call is on the record, by line, staff, and outcome.

hotline-analytics.title: Know your line
hotline-analytics.body: Calls by day and hour, categories, staff performance and cases created.
hotline-analytics.vo: And analytics show your call volume, peak hours, and team performance.

hotline-roles.title: Private by design
hotline-roles.body: You choose who gets hotline access, section by section. Transcript access is audit-logged.
hotline-roles.vo: Private by design. You choose exactly who gets hotline access, section by section, and transcript access is audit logged.

shelter-board.title: A bed board, not a whiteboard
shelter-board.body: Available, occupied, reserved, maintenance, out of service. Tonight's count is the real count.
shelter-board.vo: A bed board, not a whiteboard. Every bed is available, occupied, reserved, or out of service, so tonight's count is the real count.

shelter-checkin.title: Walk-in check-in, in minutes
shelter-checkin.body: Checking in a new client creates their record on the spot. Shelter intake and case intake are one step.
shelter-checkin.vo: Check in a walk-in in minutes. The client record is created on the spot.

shelter-waitlist.title: Waitlist, beside your beds
shelter-waitlist.body: Priority, party size and bed preference, ready to assign when a bed opens.
shelter-waitlist.vo: Your waitlist sits right beside your beds.

shelter-rollcall.title: Nightly roll call
shelter-rollcall.body: One card per stay, families included. Untick whoever didn't sleep here.
shelter-rollcall.vo: Take the nightly roll call, one card per stay.

shelter-transfer.title: Transfers across locations
shelter-transfer.body: Move a client to any open bed, at any of your shelters.
shelter-transfer.vo: Move a client to any open bed, at any of your locations.

shelter-partners.title: Partner shelters
shelter-partners.body: See open beds at your partner agencies. Availability only, never bed details.
shelter-partners.vo: See open beds at your partner agencies,

shelter-app-requests.title: Requests from the NECX app
shelter-app-requests.body: Bed requests from clients' phones arrive in their own inbox: accept, waitlist or decline.
shelter-app-requests.vo: Bed requests from the NECX app arrive in their own inbox.

shelter-incidents.title: Incidents, on record
shelter-incidents.body: Log incidents by type and severity, right where they happened.

reports-library.title: The NECX Reports Library
reports-library.body: Every validator, funder report and grant tool your agency has, in one place.
reports-library.vo: So the NECX Reports Library puts every funder report in one place.

reports-grants.title: Grants, set up once
reports-grants.body: VOCA, FVPSA, VAWA STOP, HHSC: each grant with its program, contract dates and template.
reports-grants.vo: Set up each grant once, with its program and contract dates,

reports-case-grant.title: Every case, tagged to its grant
reports-case-grant.body: Each case carries its funding source, so services count toward the right grant from day one.
reports-case-grant.vo: In VS360, every case is tagged to the grant that funds it,

reports-grant-form.title: The numbers funders ask for
reports-grant-form.body: Federal award number, state-assigned subaward number, project dates.
reports-grant-form.vo: and the award numbers your funders ask for.

reports-staff-hours.title: Staff time, by funding source
reports-staff-hours.body: Hours logged against each grant, by staff member, for any date range.
reports-staff-hours.vo: and staff time is logged against each funding source.

ai-builder.title: The NECX AI report builder
ai-builder.body: Board reports, grant progress reports, quarterly summaries, annual impact reports.
ai-builder.vo: And for board reports, grant progress reports, and annual impact reports, the NECX AI report builder writes them for you.

ai-report.title: Built from your live data
ai-report.body: Charts, KPIs, tables and narrative, in your agency's name.
ai-report.vo: Charts, tables, and narrative, built from your live data.

ai-accuracy.title: Every figure, traced
ai-accuracy.body: Each number is traced back to your database or files. Anything not in the source is flagged.
ai-accuracy.vo: And every figure is traced back to its source, so you can trust what you send.

board-charts.title: Ready to present
board-charts.body: Trends by month, services by program, and breakdowns your board can read at a glance.
board-charts.vo: Charts, trends, and breakdowns, ready to present.

voca-ready.title: VOCA: ready for sign-off
voca-ready.body: The OVC PMT screen sheet, built from logged VOCA services and case demographics, checked against OVC's own rules.
voca-ready.vo: For VOCA, NECX builds the OVC PMT screen sheet from your logged services, and checks it against OVC's own rules before sign-off.

voca-log-service.title: Log VOCA services as you go
voca-log-service.body: Category A to E, subcategory, units and date, plus victim compensation help (Q6).
voca-log-service.vo: Staff log each VOCA service as they deliver it: the category, the subcategory, and the units.

voca-generate.title: Quarter end: pick and generate
voca-generate.body: Choose the grant, the federal fiscal year and the quarter.
voca-generate.vo: At quarter end, open the VOCA report, and pick the grant, the federal fiscal year, and the quarter.

voca-sheet.title: Q1 to Q6, done
voca-sheet.body: Individuals served, new individuals, victimizations and compensation help.

voca-reminders.title: Never miss a quarter
voca-reminders.body: Federal fiscal quarters and due-date reminders, right on the page.
voca-reminders.vo: Reminders keep the federal fiscal quarters and due dates in front of your team,

hud-projects.title: Set up once for HUD
hud-projects.body: Your HMIS organization ID, and HUD 2.01: a victim service provider reporting from a comparable database.
hud-projects.vo: Set your agency up once for HUD, as a victim service provider.

hud-rollcall.title: Bed nights, every night
hud-rollcall.body: The nightly roll call records who slept here (HUD 4.14).
hud-rollcall.vo: The nightly roll call records bed nights,

hud-missing.title: Missing HUD Data
hud-missing.body: Who in the project is still missing HUD elements, and a link to fix each one.
hud-missing.vo: Before you report, Missing HUD Data shows exactly who is missing what, with a link to fix it.

hud-sage-ready.title: Ready for Sage submission
hud-sage-ready.body: The APR is built from your records and checked the way Sage checks it.
hud-sage-ready.vo: It builds the APR, and checks it the way Sage does. Ready for Sage submission.

hud-sage-rules.title: Checked file by file
hud-sage-rules.body: Header, row and column counts, and HUD's rules for every table.
hud-sage-rules.vo: Every file is checked for structure, row by row.

fvpsa-report.title: FVPSA PPR, filled from your records
fvpsa-report.body: Shelter nights from your bed board, crisis calls from your hotline, with last year's figure beside each one.
fvpsa-report.vo: The FVPSA Performance Progress Report fills itself: shelter nights from your bed board, crisis calls from your hotline.

fvpsa-explain.title: Explain any number
fvpsa-explain.body: Every roll-call night behind a number, and every record left out, with the reason.
fvpsa-explain.vo: Click Explain to see every record behind a number, and anything left out.

fvpsa-quality.title: Checked before you certify
fvpsa-quality.body: Big changes from last year are flagged for review.
fvpsa-quality.vo: Checks flag big changes from last year,

stop-home.title: The STOP report
stop-home.body: STOP and SASP subgrantee annual progress reports, in one place.
stop-home.vo: At report time, open the STOP report.

stop-victims.title: Victims served, calculated
stop-victims.body: Victims seeking services by victimization: served, partially served, and not served.
stop-victims.vo: Victim Services is filled from your records: who sought services, served, partially served, or not served.

stop-legal.title: Legal matters and protection orders
stop-legal.body: Legal issues, providers and outcomes, and protection orders requested and granted.
stop-legal.vo: and legal matters and protection orders.

stop-quality.title: Checked before approval
stop-quality.body: Large year-over-year changes are flagged for review.
stop-quality.vo: Checks flag big year-over-year changes before approval,

hhsc-generate.title: Pick the month, generate
hhsc-generate.body: NECX builds the month's DAL7 files from your own records and checks them. Ready for sign-off.
hhsc-generate.vo: At month end, pick the month and click Generate. NECX builds every file, and checks it. Ready for sign-off.

hhsc-files.title: All 11 DAL7 files
hhsc-files.body: Line counts, records passed and failed, and warnings, file by file.
hhsc-files.vo: All eleven files, with every record passed, and nothing failed.

hhsc-hotline.title: Hotline calls, by HHSC topic
hhsc-hotline.body: Each call's wrap-up records the HHSC call topic for the hotline report.
hhsc-hotline.vo: and every hotline call is wrapped up with its HHSC call topic.

vclg-quality.title: Caught before the OAG sees it
vclg-quality.body: A hospital accompaniment under 45 minutes, a service by unfunded staff, a missing age.
vclg-quality.vo: Checks catch what the OAG would: a hospital accompaniment under forty-five minutes, or a service by unfunded staff.

vclg-signoff.title: Signed by the Grant Contact
vclg-signoff.body: Section 7 data verification: initials and date go into the workbook.
vclg-signoff.vo: Then the Grant Contact signs off,

staff-roles.title: Roles that fit your agency
staff-roles.body: Each role lists the modules it opens, and where it applies: VS360 Web, the Workspace app, or both.
staff-roles.vo: Build roles that match how your agency works, each with exactly the modules it needs.

staff-role-actions.title: Down to each action
staff-role-actions.body: This case manager can view, add and edit cases, but not delete them. Without View all, they see new cases and the ones they handle.
staff-role-actions.vo: Then set every action. This case manager can view, add, and edit cases, but can't delete them, and only sees the cases they work on.

staff-team.title: Your whole team
staff-team.body: Everyone on staff, with their role and whether they're active.
staff-team.vo: Your staff list shows everyone, with their role and status.

staff-offboard.title: When someone leaves
staff-offboard.body: Change their role, switch their code to text, or deactivate them in one click.
staff-offboard.vo: And when someone leaves, deactivate them in one click.

calendar-month.title: Your whole month
calendar-month.body: Appointments, court dates and hotline callbacks on one calendar, colored by priority.
calendar-month.vo: Appointments, court dates, and hotline callbacks, all on one calendar.

calendar-court.title: Reminders for staff and client
calendar-court.body: Remind the team and the client before it starts: in the app, by email, or both.
calendar-court.vo: Reminders go to the team and to the client, in the app or by email.

time-hours.title: Hours by funding source
time-hours.body: Hours per grant and per staff member, for any date range, ready for your funders.
time-hours.vo: Then see staff hours by funding source, for any period, ready for your funders.

notes-list.title: Every note, one place
notes-list.body: Every case note across your caseload, with today, this week and this month at a glance.
notes-list.vo: Notes Center brings every case note into one place.

drive.title: One drive, every view
drive.body: My Drive, Shared with me, Agency Drive and Starred, side by side.
drive.vo: NECX Drive gives your team My Drive, Shared with me, Agency Drive, and Starred.

drive-links.title: Links that expire
drive-links.body: Share links expire after 1, 7 or 30 days, and you can revoke any link whenever you want.
drive-links.vo: Or create a share link that expires in a day, a week, or a month, and revoke it whenever you want.

network.title: Your Network
network.body: Agencies on NECX, with the services they offer and whether they're accepting referrals.
network.vo: Network shows the agencies on NECX, with the services they offer, and whether they're accepting referrals.

network-chat.title: Chat with partner agencies
network-chat.body: Agency chats are shared by the staff at both agencies, so no one works alone.
network-chat.vo: Chat with partner agencies too. Everyone at both agencies can read and reply.

services-catalog.title: Your service catalog
services-catalog.body: Every service your agency offers, grouped by category.
services-catalog.vo: Start with your catalog: every service your agency offers, grouped by category.
